subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept the custom cooperative glob walker and yielded bootstrap-hook scheduling as the permanent compatibility boundary for existing bootstrap-extra-files configurations and handlers?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes filesystem traversal and callback scheduling semantics; tests and proof reduce risk, but owner intent is required for this compatibility-sensitive runtime boundary.

options.title: Accept with exact-head gates
options.body: Approve the boundary after focused parity, SDK-surface, and embedded-run validation passes on the current head.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Keep async root-file reads and diagnostics but defer the custom glob walker or hook scheduling until stronger cross-platform parity proof exists.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Require a different cooperative scheduling design that retains the dependency's traversal implementation rather than maintaining a custom matcher.

recommendation.title: Accept with exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Approve the boundary after focused parity, SDK-surface, and embedded-run validation passes on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline provides the strongest available direct routing signal for this agents-runtime choice.
